notes.title: Unblock Gridlock Update
notes.content:
[b]Unblock Gridlock V1.01 is live! [/b]

You brought up issues and we listened! Two bugs highlighted by the community have been squashed!

[list]
[*] Audio Sliders now mute audio properly
[*] Puzzle completion stats and achievements now display and unlock properly.
[/list]

We hope you continue playing and we love to hear your feedback!

tags.bug: [*] Audio Sliders now mute audio properly
[*] Puzzle completion stats and achievements now display and unlock properly.
